tools.name: diagnose_domain
tools.description: Audit a domain's SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, alignment, BIMI, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT configuration when troubleshooting email authentication or spam delivery. Takes a domain, optional checks and DKIM selectors, and fresh=true to bypass cached results. Returns a graded scorecard, findings, proposed DNS fixes

tools.name: analyze_email_headers
tools.description: Analyze raw email headers supplied by the user to investigate authentication or delivery issues. Returns the SPF, DKIM and DMARC results reported in those headers, alignment, sending IP and detected issues. tools.name: generate_dns_records
tools.description: Propose email-authentication DNS records and policy files for a domain using its DNS configuration and optional provider names or IDs. Supports baseline (monitoring) or enforce goals; baseline is the default. Returns typed SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT proposals or provider setup instruction

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "diagnose_domain" stacks urgency/override words (never, bypass). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_inbox_test, get_inbox_test, get_dmarc_summary · Private data: diagnose_domain, generate_dns_records · Public sink: diagnose_domain, analyze_email_headers, generate_dns_records, start_inbox_test, get_inbox_test · Destructive: add_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_inbox_test, get_inbox_test, get_dmarc_summary · Private data: diagnose_domain, generate_dns_records · Public sink: diagnose_domain, analyze_email_headers, generate_dns_records, start_inbox_test, get_inbox_test · Destructive: add_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
